infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wecycle uses your camera so you can take photos of items you're sharing, selling, or reporting as lost or found.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wecycle accesses your photo library so you can attach existing photos to your listings, requests, and lost & found posts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Wecycle saves screenshots and shared images to your photo library when you tap save.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wecycle uses your microphone only when you record audio for a video post.
